## ExecOptions.env property

Extra/overriding environment variables layered onto the host process's inherited environment — existing variables not named here are preserved. The Node bridge ([createNodeHost()](./wasm.createnodehost.md)<!-- -->) implements this as `{ ...process.env, ...env }`<!-- -->. Omit to leave the environment untouched.

**Signature:**

```typescript
env?: Record<string, string>;
```
